spots.name: Egyptian Museum

spots.name: Cairo Citadel
spots.summary: The Citadel of Cairo or Citadel of Saladin is a medieval Islamic-era fortification in Cairo, Egypt. Its construction was begun by Salah ad-Din al-Ayubi (Saladin) in 1176 and continued by subsequent Egyptian rulers.

names.ja: サラーフッディーン城

names.ja: イブン＝トゥールーン・モスク

spots.name: Al-Rifa'i Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

names.ja: アッ＝リファーイー・モスク

spots.name: Tahrir Square
spots.summary: Tahrir Square, also known as Martyr Square, is a public town square in downtown Cairo, Egypt. The square has been the location and focus for political demonstrations. The 2011 Egyptian revolution and the resignation of President Hosni Mubarak occurred at the Tahrir Square.

names.ja: タハリール広場

spots.name: Mosque-Madrasa of Sultan Hasan

spots.summary: The Mosque-Madrasa of Sultan Hasan is a monumental mosque and madrasa located in Salah al-Din Square in the historic district of Cairo, Egypt. It was built between 1356 and 1363 CE during the Bahri Mamluk period, commissioned by Sultan an-Nasir Hasan.

names.ja: スルタン・ハッサン・モスク

spots.name: Muhammad Ali Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Muhammad Ali Mosque, also known as the Mosque of Muhammad Ali, is a mosque located in the Citadel of Cairo, Egypt. It was commissioned by Muhammad Ali Pasha and built between 1832 and 1857. Overlooking the city, it is one of the most visible mosques and landmarks in the skyline of Cairo.

names.ja: ムハンマド・アリー・モスク

spots.summary: The City of the Dead, or Cairo Necropolis, also referred to as the Qarāfa, is a series of vast Islamic-era necropolises and cemeteries in Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Al-Azhar Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Al-Azhar Mosque, known in Egypt simply as al-Azhar, is a mosque in the historic Islamic core of the city of Cairo, Egypt. Commissioned as the new capital of the Fatimid Caliphate in 970 CE, it was the first mosque established in a city that eventually earned the nickname "the City of a Thousand Minarets".

names.ja: アズハル・モスク

spots.name: Hanging Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Saint Virgin Mary's Coptic Orthodox Church, also known as the Hanging Church, is one of the oldest churches in Egypt which dates to the third century. It belongs to the Coptic Orthodox Church of Alexandria.

names.ja: ハンギング・チャーチ

spots.summary: The Gayer-Anderson Museum is an art museum located in Cairo, Egypt. It is situated adjacent to the Mosque of Ahmad ibn Tulun in the Sayyida Zeinab neighborhood.

spots.name: Babylon Fortress
spots.summary: Babylon Fortress is an ancient Roman fortress on the eastern bank of the Nile Delta, located in the area known today as Old Cairo or Coptic Cairo.

names.ja: バビロン

spots.name: Cairo Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cairo Tower is a free-standing concrete tower in Cairo, Egypt. At 187 m (614 ft), it was the tallest structure in Egypt for 37 years until 1998, when it was surpassed by the Suez Canal overhead powerline crossing.

names.ja: カイロ・タワー

spots.name: Museum of Islamic Art

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Museum of Islamic Art is a museum in Cairo, Egypt. The museum has a collection of rare woodwork and plaster artefacts, as well as metal, ceramic, glass, crystal, and textile objects of all periods, from all over the Islamic world.

names.es: Museo de Arte Islámico de El Cairo

spots.name: Al-Hakim Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The al-Hakim Mosque, also known as al-Anwar, is a mosque in Cairo, Egypt. It is named after al-Ḥākim bi-Amr Allāh (985–1021), the 6th Fatimid caliph and 16th Ismāʿīlī Imam. Construction of the mosque was originally started by Caliph al-ʿAziz, the son of al-Muʿizz and the father of al-Ḥākim, in 990 CE.

spots.name: Ben Ezra Synagogue

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Ben Ezra Synagogue, sometimes referred to as the Geniza Synagogue, originally the Synagogue of the Levantines, or the Synagogue of the Jerusalemites is a former Jewish congregation and synagogue, located in the Fustat part of Old Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Amr ibn al-As Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Amr ibn al-As Mosque is a mosque, located in the Fustat neighbourhood of Old Cairo, Egypt. Named in honour of the Arab Muslim commander Amr ibn al-As, the mosque was built in c. 642 CE as the centre of the newly founded capital of Egypt, Fustat.

names.ja: アムル・イブン・アル＝アース・モスク
names.zh: 阿姆鲁·伊本·阿斯清真寺

spots.name: Al-Hussein Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The al-Hussein Mosque is a mosque and mausoleum, located near the Khan el-Khalili bazaar in Cairo, Egypt. Containing the tomb of Husayn ibn Ali that was originally built in 1154, the mosque and mausoleum were reconstructed in 1874.

names.ja: マスジド・イマーム・フサイン

spots.name: Coptic Museum
spots.summary: The Coptic Museum is a museum in Coptic Cairo, Egypt, which contains the largest collection of Coptic Christian artifacts in the world. It was founded by Marcus Simaika in 1908 to house Coptic antiquities. The museum traces the history of Egypt from its beginnings to the present day.

names.ja: コプト博物館

spots.name: Al-Sayeda Zainab Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sayyida Zaynab Mosque is a mosque and mausoleum located on Portsaid Street in the Sayyidah Zainab District of Islamic Cairo, Egypt. It is one of the largest and most important mosques of the city.

spots.name: Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church, also known as the Abu Serga Church, is one of the oldest Coptic Christian churches in Egypt, dating back to the 7th century. Located in Old Cairo, this church is significant to Christians for its connection to the flight of the Holy Family into Egypt.

names.es: Iglesia de los santos Sergio y Baco
names.it: Chiesa dei Santi Sergio e Bacco
names.ja: アブ・サルガ教会

spots.name: Giza Zoo
spots.summary: The Giza Zoo is a zoological garden in Giza, Egypt. It is one of the few green areas in the city, and includes Giza's largest park. The zoo covers about 80 acres (32 ha), and is home to many endangered species, as well as a selection of endemic fauna.

names.ja: ギーザ動物園

spots.name: Agricultural Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Agricultural Museum is a museum in Giza, Egypt.

names.ja: エジプト農業博物館

spots.name: Aqsunqur Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Aqsunqur Mosque, also known as the Blue Mosque, or the Mosque of Ibrahim Agha, is a mosque located in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. The mosque is situated in the Tabbana Quarter of Darb al-Ahmar district, between Bab Zuweila and the Citadel of Cairo.

spots.name: Church of St. George

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Church of St. George is a Greek Orthodox church within the Babylon Fortress in Coptic Cairo. It is part of the Holy Patriarchal Monastery of St George under the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate of Alexandria and all Africa.

names.ja: 聖ジョージ教会

spots.name: Bab Zuwayla
spots.summary: Bab Zuwayla or Bab Zuweila is one of three remaining gates in the city walls of historic Cairo in Egypt. It was also known as Bawabat al-Mitwali or Bab al-Mitwali. The gate was built in 1092 by the Fatimid vizier Badr al-Jamali.

names.ja: ズワイラ門

spots.name: Al-Mu'izz Street
spots.summary: Al-Muizz li-Din Allah al-Fatimi Street, or al-Muizz Street for short, is a major north-to-south street in the walled city of historic Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Al-Nasir Muhammad Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Al-Nasir Muhammad Mosque, or more formally, the Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad ibn Qalawun Mosque, is a mosque located in the Citadel of Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Funerary complex of Sultan Barquq

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Funerary complex of Sultan Barquq is an Islamic religious complex in the historic district of Cairo, Egypt. The complex was commissioned by Sultan al-Zahir Barquq, the first sultan of the Burji line of Mamluk sultans. Its construction took place between 1384 and 1386.

spots.name: Sayeda Aisha Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sayyida Aisha Mosque is a mosque and mausoleum, located near Salah ad-din Square on a similarly named street in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. The mosque contains the tomb of Aisha bint Ja'far al-Sadiq, a female scholar who was one of the daughters of Ja'far al-Sadiq, and the mosque was named in her honour.

spots.name: Sultan Qaytbay Complex

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The funerary complex of Sultan Qaytbay, is an Islamic religious funerary complex located in the Northern Cemetery of Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Manial Palace and Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Manial Palace and Museum is a former Alawiyya dynasty era palace and grounds on Rhoda Island on the Nile. It is of Ottoman architecture and located in the Sharia Al-Saray area in the El-Manial district of southern Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Al-Sayyida Nafisa Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Al-Sayyida Nafisa Mosque is a mosque located in the al-Sayyida Nafisa district, a section of the larger historic necropolis called al-Qarafa in Islamic Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Egyptian National Military Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Egyptian National Military Museum is the official museum of the Egyptian Army, Egyptian Armed Forces. It is located in the Cairo Citadel in Cairo, Egypt.

names.ja: エジプト国立軍事博物館

spots.name: Cairo Citadel Clock

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cairo Citadel Clock is a 19th century French clock tower situated at the Cairo Citadel, and Egypt's first public ticking clock.

spots.name: 6th of October Panorama

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The 6th of October War Panorama is a museum and memorial to the 1973 October war, located in Heliopolis, Cairo. Constructed over an area of 7.5 feddans, it was inaugurated on 5 October 1989 by former Egyptian president Hosni Mubarak.

names.ja: 10月6日全景

spots.name: Wikala of al-Ghuri
spots.summary: The Wikala of Sultan Qansuh al-Ghuri is a caravanserai in medieval Cairo, Egypt. It was built in 1504–1505 and is considered today one of the most impressive and best-preserved examples of this type of building in Cairo.

spots.name: Mosque of Qani-Bay

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mosque of Qani-Bay is a mosque near the Salah al-Din Square in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. The complex is named after Qani-Bay al-Sayfi, nicknamed "al-Rammah", who was Grand Master of the Horse during the reign of Sultan al-Ghuri.

spots.name: Egyptian National Library and Archives

hours.note: Closed Sun; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Egyptian National Library and Archives is located in Nile Corniche, Cairo and is the largest library in Egypt, followed by Al-Azhar University and the Bibliotheca Alexandrina. The Egyptian National Library and Archives are a non-profit government organization.

names.es: Biblioteca Nacional y Archivos de Egipto
names.ja: エジプト国立図書館・公文書館
names.zh: 埃及国家图书馆和档案馆

spots.name: Qasr El Nil Bridge
spots.summary: The Qasr el Nil Bridge, is a historic swing bridge structure dating from 1931 which replaced the first bridge to span the Nile River in central Cairo, Egypt. It connects Tahrir Square in Downtown Cairo on the east bank of the river, to the southern end of Gezira/Zamalek Island.

names.ja: カスル・アン＝ニール橋

spots.name: Sulayman Pasha Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sulayman Pasha Mosque, also known as the Sulayman Pasha al-Khadem Mosque, and as the Sariat al-Jabal Mosque, is a mosque, mausoleum and shrine, located inside the Citadel at the top of Mount Mokattam, in Islamic Cairo, Egypt.

names.ja: スライマン・パシャ・モスク

spots.name: Bab al-Nasr
spots.summary: Bab al-Nasr, is one of three remaining gates in the historic city wall of Cairo, the capital of Egypt. The gate's construction is dated to 1087 and was ordered by Badr al-Jamali, a Fatimid vizier.

names.ja: ナスル門

spots.name: Aqmar Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Aqmar Mosque or al-Aqmar Mosque, is a mosque located in Cairo, Egypt.

names.ja: アクマル・モスク

spots.name: Stela of Queen Tetisheri
spots.summary: The Stela of Tetisheri is a limestone donation stele erected by Pharaoh Ahmose I, founder of the Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt.

spots.name: Al-Azhar Park
spots.summary: Al-Azhar Park is a public park located in qism al-Darb al-Ahmar, in Historic Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Mosque of Sultan al-Muayyad

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mosque of Sultan al-Mu'ayyad, is a mosque on al-Mu'izz Street, adjacent to Bab Zuwayla, in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. The complex was built between 1415 and 1421, under the rule of the Mamluk sultan al-Mu'ayyad Shaykh, from whom it takes its name.

spots.name: Al-Gawhara Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Al-Gawhara Palace, also known as Bijou Palace, is a palace and museum in Cairo, Egypt. The palace is situated south of the Mosque of Muhammad Ali in the Cairo Citadel. It was commissioned by Muhammad Ali Pasha in 1814.

spots.name: Unknown Soldier Memorial
spots.summary: The Unknown Soldier Memorial in Cairo is a pyramid-shaped monument in Nasr City. Its construction was ordered by president Anwar Sadat in 1974 in honor of Egyptians and Arabs who lost their lives in the 1973 October War. It was inaugurated in October 1975.

names.ja: エジプト無名戦士記念碑

spots.name: Amir Khayrbak Funerary Complex

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Amir Khayrbak Funerary Complex, also known as the Mosque-Madrasa of Al-Amir Khair Bak, and as the Khayrbak Mosque, is an Islamic religious funerary complex located at Bab al-Wazir street, in the Darb al-Ahmar district of Islamic Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Bab al-Futuh
spots.summary: Bab al-Futuh is one of three remaining gates in the city wall of the old city of Cairo, Egypt. It is located at the northern end of al-Mu'izz Street. The other two remaining gates are Bab al-Nasr in the north and Bab Zuwayla in the south.

spots.name: Madrasa of al-Nasir Muhammad

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Madrasa of al-Nasir Muhammad is a madrasa and mausoleum located in the Bayn al-Qasrayn area of al-Muizz street in Islamic Cairo, Egypt.

spots.name: Sabil-Kuttab of Abd al-Rahman Katkhuda
spots.summary: Sabil-Kuttab of Abd al-Rahman Katkhuda is a historic monument in the historic district of Cairo, Egypt. It comprises a public fountain or sabil, an elementary Quran school or kuttab, and an adjacent residential wing.

spots.name: Saint Barbara Church in Coptic Cairo

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Coptic Orthodox Church of St. Barbara is one of the many famous Coptic Orthodox parishes that can be found in the district of Coptic Cairo. The building is located on the eastern part of the Babylon Fortress and is one of the oldest buildings in Cairo, dating back to the 5th or 6th century AD.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Saint Barbara Church in Coptic Cairo

names.ja: 聖バルバラ教会

spots.name: Beshtak Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Beshtak Palace or Qasr Bashtak is a historic palace and museum in Cairo, Egypt, built in the 14th century by the Mamluk amir Sayf al-Din Bashtak al-Nasiri. It is located on Shari'a al-Mu'izz, in the area known as Bayn al-Qasrayn.

spots.name: Al-Mahmoudia Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Al-Mahmoudia Mosque, also known as the Mosque of Mahmud Pasha, is a mosque and mausoleum, located in the Salah al-Din Square in the Citadel area of Islamic Cairo, Egypt. It is situated in front of Bab al-Azab gate of the citadel. The Sultan Hassan Mosque and Al-Rifa'i Mosque are adjacent, to the east.

spots.name: Madrasa of Sarghatmish

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Madrasa of Sarghatmish is a madrasa, mosque, and mausoleum, located on Saliba Street in Islamic Cairo, Egypt. Completed in 1356 CE, lthe cruciform building is located to the northeast of the Mosque of Ibn Tulun. The structure's school, mosque, and mausoleum can be seen from Ibn Tulun's spiral minaret.

spots.name: Sultan al-Ghuri Complex

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Sultan al-Ghuri Complex, also known as the Funerary complex of Sultan al-Ghuri, and as the al-Ghuriya, is a monumental Islamic religious and funerary complex built by the Mamluk sultan Qansuh al-Ghuri between 1503 and 1505 CE.

names.ja: ワカーラトゥル＝グーリー

spots.name: Mosque of Amir al-Maridani

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Mosque of Amir al-Maridani, also known as the Mosque of Amir Altinbugha al-Maridani, is a mosque located south of Bab Zuweila, in the Darb al-Ahmar neighbourhood of Islamic Cairo, Egypt. The mosque dates from 1340 CE, during the Mamluk Sultanate era.

spots.name: Bayt al-Sihaymi
spots.summary: Possibly the best-preserved Ottoman merchant house (16-17th century) in Cairo. Little visited and a place of quiet beauty. It's a museum now.

spots.name: Khan El Khalily
spots.summary: Cairo's souk area where visitors will find many merchants selling perfume, spices, gold, Egyptian handicrafts.

names.ja: ハーネルハリーリー

spots.name: Didos Al Dente

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: This place serves pasta, and dishes are amazingly cheap, ranging from LE6-20. Small, intimate setting, making it an excellent spot for dates (despite its small setting, the waiters will let you linger/flirt at the table). Generally full from 5PM-close, waiting on the street outside is common, but it is worth the wait. They serve up some of the best pasta in all of Cairo. You pick your sauce, you p

spots.name: The Greek Club

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Mostly frequented by liberal and leftist Egyptians rather than Greeks, this is one of the best restaurants in Downtown Cairo. The Greek food offered is limited and the menu often erratic, but the dishes they do have in supply are very good and cheap. Alcohol (including imported spirits) is served and it's possible to just have a drink. Some of the best Kofte in Cairo. Closes down completely during

spots.name: Le Pacha
spots.summary: A complex on a Nile boat with several restaurants and cafes inside the boat. Very tasty food and professional service for an upscale price. Le Tarbouche restaurant which serves hearty traditional Egyptian food. In particular, desserts are great. Also, allows to take home food. Has a good view of the Nile.

spots.name: Akram Gad Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Fast food restaurant, done Egyptian style. Usually very busy packed with locals, but very good food at a very non-tourist price. Good fuul and falafel. Large restaurant on 26th July St, just off Talaat Harb St, in downtown Cairo. They also offer a large schawerma 'Doner kebab sandwich' .

spots.name: Le Grillon Restaurant & Garden Cafe
spots.summary: This is a warm and charming old-school restaurant. Serving traditional plates like mixed grill, fatoush and tahine salad, etc. Serves alcohol (beer) and shisha. Mains are around US$10 and soups & salads are US$3. Old songs are played. Many foreigners. Doesn't accept Visa.

spots.name: Abou al-Sid

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Owned by the conglomerate also responsible for Tabouleh (a rockin' awesome Lebanese restaurant in Garden City), and L'Aubergine, Abou al-Sid features high-end Egyptian cuisine and superb fresh juices. Very atmospheric. Make reservations in advance and dress up to get in.

spots.name: Odeon
spots.summary: This roof-top open-air hotel bar is also a restaurant, but most visitors prefer just to drink or have shisha. Beer (Stella or Saqqara) is LE15. Very popular among backpackers and foreign students. Open during Ramadan. Nice place to sit and have a drink, but poor service.

spots.name: Simonds

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: A small, long-established and highly popular café frequented by expats and students. Rather intimate, space is at a premium with just a few stools available or stand at the bar. Very good cappuccino. A great selection of sweets, pastries and juices is also on offer.

spots.name: Pub 28

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Imitating a British pub frequented by expats and locals alike. International brands of liquor. Food served. Very popular, reserve a table if you are not content sitting in the bar (but you'll have to eat a meal then). Open during Ramdan. Stella , main dishes from .

spots.name: Koshary Abou Tarek

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Koshary is a filling pasta, tomato sauce, dried onions, chickpeas, lenses dish, and this restaurant is quite famous beyond Cairo for it and its speedy waiters. Rice with mild seems to be quite famous in combination (after) koshary.

spots.name: Cilantro

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Another branch in the Om Kolsoum Hotel on Abu el-Feda just north of the 26th July St Bridge crossing to Agouza. Part of a local coffee shop chain (think Starbucks) with pastries, light sandwiches, sodas, and free wi-fi.

spots.name: Karam El Sham

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: There are big crowds and queues outside but for good reason. The staff makes a real effort to speak English to help you order and receive vour food after waiting. Both the sharwama and the rice are tasty.

spots.name: Fish & Chips

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The place is nostalgic of good old times. It's cozy and a bit quirky. Nice decorations. The crunchy bread slices are unique. It's a woman-run business. The shrimp stuffed fillet is delicious.

spots.name: L'Amphitryon

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Amphitrion is an open air cafe and pub, providing a place to sit outdoors on the terrace with a beer. As old as Heliopolis itself, soldiers used to come here to unwind during World War II.

spots.name: Maison Thomas
spots.summary: Legendary establishment (Om Kolsoum once ate here) serving pastries, light food, and pizza. Owned by Coptic Christians. Beer available for take-away except during Ramadan.

spots.name: Nile City

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Stationary boat on the Nile includes several international franchises coupled an Egyptian grill and a seafood restaurant. Chilis, Johny Carinos, Fish Market & Studio Misr.

spots.name: Al Tahreer Koshary Restaurant

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Popular koshari chain, serves koshari in various sizes though the small (1.4 kg/3 lb) is a good size portion. You can add hot sauce or a lemon sauce. Eat-in or takeaway.

spots.name: Sip
spots.summary: Specialty coffee with interesting cakes and good (comparing to Egyptian standards) coffee. Also good for working as WiFi is stable and inside area is comfortable.

spots.name: Champollion Palace cafes

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The cafes in the shaded alleys to the east and rear of the wrongly named Champollion Palace provide a lovely shaded respite from the noise of the city.

spots.name: Deals
spots.summary: Another popular pub haunt. Cable TV, DJ and house music. Pub menu. Open during Ramadan. Stella LE15, main dishes from LE25-60.
